agreement_long: The consent declaration is only needed if you want to send data to enhance the app.
agreement_text:
I agree that, in order to improve the technical function, the data created by the SleepDoctor or the SleepDoctor app, i.e. data about my sleep behavior, may be transferred to the person responsible - Iptasys GmbH - and that the data will be processed, including the deletion of the Data may include. 

The consent is given on a voluntary basis and is not necessary to be able to use the SleepDoctor or the SleepDoctor app. You can revoke your consent at any time with future effect. After receipt of the declaration of revocation, your data may no longer be processed. They are to be deleted immediately. Withdrawing your consent does not affect the legality of the processing carried out on the basis of your consent up to the point of withdrawal. 

You have the right to delete, block, correct and transfer the data, as well as to information about the data processing. You can also complain to the responsible supervisory authority. For further explanations, we refer to our data protection declaration, available at www.sleepdoctor.de
